title: MOXIE
description: Documented public ISRU demonstration (NASA / MIT) for the In-Situ Resource Utilization Planner capability area.
body:
MOXIE is a documented ISRU demonstration from NASA / MIT. Demonstrated making breathable oxygen from Martian CO2 on the surface of Mars — the first ISRU hardware operated on another planet.

How it works: It works by multiplying the daily production rate by the operating days and comparing total propellant against the plant mass for the payback ratio.

Documented uses of this capability area include interplanetary trajectory design, space-station operations, lunar base planning, and asteroid resource assessment.

title: Kilopower / KRUSTY
description: Documented public surface fission power (NASA / DOE) for the In-Situ Resource Utilization Planner capability area.
body:
Kilopower / KRUSTY is a documented surface fission power from NASA / DOE. Kilowatt-class fission reactor tested at full power (KRUSTY, 2018) — the power source sized for ISRU plants and bases.

How it works: It works by summing the load list against the generation capacity and reporting the margin in watts and percent.

Documented uses of this capability area include interplanetary trajectory design, space-station operations, lunar base planning, and asteroid resource assessment.
